description: Simulation snapshot on a mission of the game: linia61_osobowy1 (Czestochowa - Kepno, 2003 timetable), five EN57 units and a locomotive hauled express on their timetables, standing rakes and road traffic. A snapshot is taken at 300 s; the run loaded from it is compared at 600 s with the run that went on. The express has coaches sharing a name, which the snapshot tells apart by their place in the scenery.
